title: November 2025: Custom moderation, deeper analytics, bulk duplication, and a smarter Sparky
summary: This update is all about giving teachers and admins more control, clarity, and convenience. Plus, an even sharper Sparky to power it all.
body_markdown:
November’s here: ‘tis the season of grading marathons, report cards, and “wait, how is it almost winter break?” moments. We can’t help with your coffee supply (yet), but we *can* make your Flint experience smoother, smarter, and a lot more fun.


This month’s updates are all about giving you more control and clarity, from giving you **finer moderation settings** and **better analytics** to letting you **duplicate activities** in bulk and rely on **Sparky’s ever-growing brain** .


So grab that extra-large mug, take a deep breath, and let’s dive in ☕.
